# onetsolutions_hosting_php_versions (Data Source)

Lists the PHP versions a web hosting offers and the version each of its domains runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_hosting_php_versions" "site" {
  hosting_id = onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "php_versions" {
  value = [for v in data.onetsolutions_hosting_php_versions.site.versions : v.version]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The domains of the web hosting, with the PHP version each runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `versions` (Attributes List) The PHP versions the web hosting offers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The domain.
- `php_version` (String) Its PHP version, `inherit` when it runs the account's default.


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `display` (String) A readable name of the version.
- `version` (String) The version, as `php_version` of `onetsolutions_hosting_php_version` takes it.
